claim: Each replacement edits only the linked Horn definition of Link-as-substitution. The generic Horn resolver, the lambda-link meta-semantics and every request stay unchanged.

replacements.description: D resolves a variable to its nearest enclosing binder; D' resolves it to the outermost binder with the same name.
replace:
(horn-clause scope-here (scope-choice yes ?name ?scope ?index)
  (shadowed ?name ?scope ?outer) (outermost-choice ?outer ?name ?scope ?index))
(horn-clause shadowed-end (shadowed ?name end no))
(horn-clause shadowed-next (shadowed ?name (cons ?bound ?scope) ?result)
  (code-equal ?name ?bound ?same) (shadowed-choice ?same ?name ?scope ?result))
(horn-clause shadowed-yes (shadowed-choice yes ?name ?scope yes))
(horn-clause shadowed-no (shadowed-choice no ?name ?scope ?result) (shadowed ?name ?scope ?result))
(horn-clause outermost-here (outermost-choice no ?name ?scope zero))
(horn-clause outermost-outer (outermost-choice yes ?name ?scope (successor ?index)) (scope-index ?name ?scope ?index))

replacements.description: D binds an unevaluated argument closure (call by name); D' first evaluates the argument to weak head form, so an unused divergent argument no longer gets discarded.
